raw.details:
RootAccess — Overnight Sustainability Hackathon

Go to the problem’s root and code the change.

Organised by Paryavaran Welfare Society, Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology

About the Hackathon:

RootAccess is an overnight, offline hackathon that brings together innovative minds to develop technology-driven solutions for real-world environmental and sustainability challenges. Collaborate, build prototypes, and turn your ideas into impactful solutions for a greener future.

Who Can Participate?

  • Open to students from all colleges and universities.
  • Team size: 2–5 members.
  • Participants from all technical backgrounds are welcome.

Rules & Guidelines:

  • Registration must be completed online through Unstop.
  • The hackathon and all subsequent activities will be conducted offline at the designated venue.
  • Teams must develop original solutions relevant to sustainability and environmental challenges.
  • Participants must report to the venue at the announced time and attend all checkpoints, evaluations, and final presentations.
  • Teams must submit and demonstrate their projects within the given timeframe.
  • Plagiarism, misrepresentation, or misconduct may result in disqualification.
  • The decisions of the organising team and judging panel will be final.

Important Information:

  • Mode: Offline
  • Duration: Overnight
  • Dates: 31 October – 1 November 2026
  • Venue: LP110, Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, Patiala
  • Registration: Online via Unstop

Register now and be part of RootAccess — where innovation meets sustainability. Build with purpose. Code the change.
